payload.application_scope: Ledger item 8 only, both halves, for one W362 packet. This is an OVERLAY: it is written beside the packet, it does not modify the packet or any of the four files the packet's own manifest covers, and it does not change the recorded W362 packet hash, which it pins instead. No coefficient module, marking, field, resolver, eta or source certificate is selected.
residual_todos: TODO: the quadratic normal form RECORDS themselves are still named_but_unbound, and this overlay does not change that. SourceOddHessian, SourceCompactHessian and SourceWallHessian remain unreachable without instantiating a coefficient module, which no exporter lane may do. What changed is that the Gauss cells no longer wait for them: they are supplied by theorems about the endpoint phase function, which is quantified over the coefficient group. Naming is not binding.

TODO: only the L rows have a second, independent record_target route for the printed sign, through LHessianCertificates.unramifiedHessian_baseSign and .ramifiedHessian_baseSign. N0 and Npc have no named baseSign theorem: the fact holds by rfl and is supplied inline as a rfl argument at the certificate call sites, which a driver cannot cite. The Npc ramified head record is nonempty_npcRamifiedHeadHessian, a Nonempty and not a record value, so that row cannot gain one even if a baseSign theorem were added.

TODO: the printed exponent has NO record-field route in any row, because no named baseDim theorem exists anywhere in the tree. Every degree_record_route in every row is therefore null, and the exponent's only binding is the GaussValCell field. Supplying a second route is four small rfl theorems in the three certificate modules, which no exporter lane may add.

paragraphs: The all-rank original source Hessian records retain the actual comparison map, proved additive and then F2-linear, with the full quadratic identity and the original affine phase fields. L uses its actual qDouble/graph operator, not a plus-form substitution. The unramified and ramified base signs are minus and plus respectively.
section.title: Change of variables to quadratic normal form

payload.sign_route_note: The before column is per family, not uniform, because W365 corrected W363-PUB2 here: the L rows' printed sign already had a record_target route through the pre-existing LHessianCertificates.unramifiedHessian_baseSign and .ramifiedHessian_baseSign, so for L this lane adds a SECOND, independent route to the display cell rather than a first binding, and a validator may check that the two agree. N0 and Npc had none: no named baseSign theorem exists outside L, and the fact is supplied inline as a rfl argument at the certificate call sites, which a driver cannot cite. The printed exponent had no route in any family, and still has none outside the cell.

payload.warning: The packet this overlay names is NOT regenerated and its hash is NOT recomputed into a new value: the hash below is the packet's own recorded hash, reproduced from the packet's stored payload by the W362 composer's own digest, and the overlay check fails if it ever stops reproducing. The overlay supersedes the packet's item-8 TODO for a reader who has both files; it does not edit the packet's text, so the packet still carries that TODO and should be read together with this file. Whether the packets are instead regenerated in place remains W363-PUB2 owner decision 13. STAGED proposal: not owner approval, not a manifest entry, not a gate.
